scoring: Five dimensions, each pass/fail; a dimension passes only if every one of its checks passes. Manual checks pass only with their evidence committed and their line ticked in docs/V11_CHECKLIST.md. Criteria are never loosened after results are seen; a wrong check is changed in a separate commit labelled 'post hoc' and reported. A miss is reported as a miss.
